name: XXXXXXXXL
description: Every floor is the size of an XL Womb floor, but does not combine the floors of each chapter.

name: SPEED!
description: Everything is sped up like the Broken Watch effect. After the game timer reaches 16 minutes, Isaac starts taking damage every 10 seconds.
unlocks: Get out of Jail Free Card

name: PAY TO PLAY
description: Every door costs 1 cent to enter. Isaac drops money when hit. Isaac dies if he runs out of money.

name: Have a Heart
description: Pennies drop instead of Red Hearts. Many items that restore Red Hearts have no effect.

name: PRIDE DAY!
description: Cannot drop or replace Rainbow Worm .

name: Onan's Streak
description: Missing a shot deals damage to Judas.

name: The Guardian
description: Isaac's Heart will follow Punching Bag instead of Isaac.

name: Backasswards
description: All chapters progress in reverse order, losing 1 item and 1 Red Heart container each floor ascended.

name: Aprils Fool
description: The minimap displays the floor's layout accurately but displays Isaac's position inaccurately. Pedestal items and pickups are not what they appear to be. Active items, pills, cards, and rune effects are randomized upon each use, making them very unreliable or deadly (for example Suicide King ). Items with no charge time (i.e. How to Jump , IV Bag , etc) can be used repeatedly for random effects. Stonies have a chance of being replaced by a Cross Stoney. Every boss is The Bloat. Isaac's health is not what it appears to be. Inventory pickups numbers are accurate.

name: Pokey Mans
description: Each use of Friendly Ball causes a random monster to be spawned. Friendly Ball instantly charges once the spawned monster is killed.

name: Ultra Hard
description: All enemies spawn as champions if possible. Boss fights will be double trouble if possible. No heart pickups drop.

name: Pong
description: Damage fixed at 100, tear rate fixed at Category:Modified in Repentance 150 / Category:Modified in Repentance 0.2.

name: Seeing Double
description: All enemies and bosses are doubled.

name: Pica Run
description:
All items are replaced by random trinkets.
 Marbles activates on every hit.

name: Hot Potato
description: The Forgotten cannot fire tears and explodes every 2.5 seconds. Explosion timer resets upon entering a room or picking up an item.

name: Cantripped!
description:
All cards and pills are replaced with item cards. Enemies also have a chance of dropping an item card when killed. The Bag of Crafting now initially holds a maximum of 3 item cards at once. When picked up, each item card shows a preview of a random active item that, when used, activates the effect.
All boss item drops are replaced with Starter Deck , which increases the max card limit by 1 and drops 3 item cards.

name: Red Redemption
description:
The starting room spawns with no rooms connected to it. Rooms spawn in clusters around the map and must be found via the Red Key . While the Red Key can be used an infinite number of times, it has 20 uses before Dark Esau spawns. Each subsequent 5 uses will spawn another Dark Esau if Tainted Jacob has yet to turn into his lost form. The Red Key cannot be used to open doors to I AM ERROR rooms.
Each floor generates as a Curse of the Labyrinth floor, with one shop, and two item and boss rooms, except the fourth floor, which has only one boss room. All rooms may be from any floor of the current chapter.

name: DELETE THIS
description:
All items are randomly generated due to TMTRAINER . The theme of each area, its obstacles per area, and music are randomized. Some obstacle sprites are randomized even within a level and sometimes the music may be missing altogether. Occasionally, even the floor texture might glitch out, replacing it with a plain color. Shop item prices range from 1 cent to 99.
The challenge itself appears under the challenge list without any text, effectively rendering it invisible.
